info.name: MORAGO API
info.description: Run 'POST /api/auth/login' first: the token is saved to {{token}} and used by the other requests.

item.name: POST /api/auth/send-code - Send an SMS code to a phone number (in development the code is returned as devCode)
POST /api/auth/register - Register a client or a translator
POST /api/auth/login - Log in with phone or email, returns a JWT
DELETE /api/auth/me - Delete my account (the account is closed, call and payment history is kept)
POST /api/auth/forgot-password - Send a password reset link by email (in development the link is written to the server l
POST /api/auth/forgot-password/phone - Send a 6-digit password reset code by SMS (in development the code is returned as
POST /api/auth/forgot-password/verify - Check the SMS code; returns a one-time token for /reset-password
POST /api/auth/reset-password - Set a new password with the token from the email
POST /api/files - Upload an image or a PDF (max 5 MB)
POST /api/files/avatar - Upload a picture and make it my avatar
GET /api/files/{id} - Open a file (image or PDF)
GET /api/translators - List translators (filters: languageId, themeId, online; sorting; pagination)
POST /api/calls - Request a call to a translator
GET /api/calls - My call history (filter by status, pagination)
POST /api/calls/{id}/cancel - Client cancels the call request
POST /api/calls/{id}/start - Mark the call as started (WebRTC connected)
POST /api/calls/{id}/end - End the call; duration and cost are calculated
GET /api/wallet/topup-info - Bank account for top-ups and the minimum amount
POST /api/wallet/topups - Create a top-up request (an administrator confirms it)
POST /api/conversations - Start a conversation with a translator
POST /api/notifications/read-all - Mark all notifications as read
POST /api/admin/users/{id}/charge - Add money to a user's balance
PATCH /api/admin/translators/{id}/verification - Approve, reject or schedule an interview
PATCH /api/admin/topups/{id} - Confirm or reject a top-up
PATCH /api/admin/payouts/{id} - Mark a withdrawal as paid or rejected
GET /api/admin/categories - All categories including hidden ones
PATCH /api/admin/categories/{id} - Edit or hide a category
DELETE /api/admin/categories/{id} - Delete a category (hidden if it has themes)
GET /api/admin/themes - All themes including hidden ones
PATCH /api/admin/themes/{id} - Edit or hide a theme
DELETE /api/admin/themes/{id} - Delete a theme (hidden if it was used in calls)
